scope: Final visible Draft, exact source/article/action bytes, BookcaseDiscovery PR count and shipped detector/reader/data-path contracts, dynamic fleet discovery and registration surfaces, current C-4 and pipeline-alert state, and existing Workstation review and merge restrictions. Read-only review; no article revision or acceptance, finding disposition, action admission or settlement, readiness, merge, workflow dispatch, runtime, or scheduling authority.

findings.title: The BookcaseDiscovery sprint merged 25 PRs, not 26
findings.location: Title, summary and lines 15–17 say 26 while listing PRs #1 through #25.
findings.explanation: Twenty-five unique BookcaseDiscovery PRs merged inside the reporting window. PR #26 merged after the 03:30 Chicago cutoff; the article's all-repo total of 30 is consistent with 25 BookcaseDiscovery, one core and four daily-logger PRs.
findings.correction: Report 25 BookcaseDiscovery PRs in the reporting window while retaining the supported 30-PR all-repo total.

findings.title: Fleet registration is not a static manifest or atomic transaction
findings.location: Lines 11 and 88–92 call daily-logger a fleet manifest and the three registrations atomic.
findings.explanation: Public sweep membership is derived from the live GitHub org. PR #521 says BookcaseDiscovery was already swept and only added role/tag/prompt grounding; core path registration has a separate ordering constraint.
findings.correction: Describe three coordinated registrations with distinct effects and keep automatic sweep membership separate from grounding drift and core path validation.

findings.title: The detector and reader stack is misidentified
findings.location: Line 64 names SAM 3, Florence-2 and Qwen2.5-VL as the shipped two-reader path.
findings.explanation: F-0 shipped Grounding DINO base → SAM 2.1 as the default box arm and Apple Vision, PP-OCRv5 and Qwen3-VL-4B as readers. SAM 3 was an alternate box arm and Apple Vision is not open-weight.
findings.correction: Name the shipped B2 detector/segmenter and the three actual readers, and state the two-reader agreement plus catalog-bar rule without calling every reader open-weight.

findings.title: C-4 measures catalog coverage, not the unknown-spine rate
findings.location: Lines 68, 103, 108 and 129 call C-4 the answer to a false-negative or headline unknown-spine rate.
findings.explanation: C-4 measures ISFDB and alternate-catalog coverage over resolvable readable labels, with unresolved and match-miss shares kept separate. It does not produce a single accuracy-labelled false-negative rate for every unknown spine.
findings.correction: Report C-4 as the catalog-gap study and keep detection, reading, matching and catalog-coverage losses separate.

findings.title: The held C-4 review and merge action is already complete
findings.location: Lines 128–129 propose reviewing and merging BookcaseDiscovery #27 as the active gate.
findings.explanation: PR #27 merged at 2026-11-03T20:07:17Z. It was still open at article capture, but by review time the proposed next step was stale and must not be duplicated.
findings.correction: Mark the candidate completed and use the landed C-4 result for subsequent R-2 scope decisions.

findings.title: Issue 516 is not a generation precondition
findings.location: Lines 128 and 130 say resolving daily-logger #516 is a precondition for the next generation run.
findings.explanation: Issue #516 remained open while scheduled run #289 generated this article, and no pinned run gate requires the alert issue to close before generation.
findings.correction: Treat #516 as an unresolved operational alert, not a scheduler or generator admission condition.

findings.title: Workstation PRs already record differentiated gates
findings.location: Lines 116, 128 and 133 say #4–#10 have no recorded merge, close or park disposition.
findings.explanation: PRs #5 and #7 record an ordered reconciliation gate. PRs #8–#10 explicitly say review-only and do not merge, and already carry substantive reviews.
findings.correction: Preserve each recorded do-not-merge or sequencing condition and ask only for unresolved decisions left by the existing reviews.

findings.title: The onboarding note points private data at repository paths
findings.location: Line 110 says the ledger and catalog live in data/ and the pilot fixture set lives in fixtures/pilot-000/.
findings.explanation: The real ledger, image store, catalog, labels and model data live under the configured $BOOKCASE_DATA root outside git. The repository's fixtures/pilot-000 path contains a privacy-safe public manifest, not the owner photos.
findings.correction: Distinguish clone-local public manifests and aggregates from the external $BOOKCASE_DATA ledger, catalog, photos, labels and weights.

findings.title: Backup-specific terms were not verified
findings.location: Line 74 says local indexing has no terms-of-service constraints.
findings.explanation: C-1 explicitly records the backup-specific terms as unverified because the downloads page was login-gated and bot-checked. The verified basis is the site's CC BY 4.0 footer, not proof of no other constraints.
findings.correction: State the verified CC BY 4.0 basis and retain the backup-specific terms as an evidence gap.
